# Dealing with Images (todo) {#sec-images}

::: {.callout-note}
**Proposed chapter scope:** Applying the tools from the previous chapters to images. Covers loading and preprocessing (resizing, metadata extraction, e.g. with `magick`), coding images with vision LLMs (the approach from @sec-llm), and image embeddings with clustering (the approach from @sec-embeddings), showing a grid of example images per cluster.

Embeddings and model outputs are precomputed/recorded; check how much the image files (or thumbnails) add to `webr.resources`. If processing a folder of images needs `map`, use it without much explanation and point forward to @sec-scraping.
:::
